Axiom: In AI-first development, an e2e test against the live runtime (not mocks) is a mandatory verification category for a feature, not an optional add-on an agent may quietly drop. Unit + lint are the floor a feature cannot ship without; e2e is what earns confidence that the floor actually holds end to end. `test-e2e` is never screened out by the agent's own hypothesis ("small task, skip it") — it is picked or waived by an explicit operator decision. When live e2e is genuinely impossible for this task, unit coverage alone is acceptable, but only as a NAMED decision carrying a one-line risk statement in the Decision Log — never a silent omission.
